webui_conf_plugin_desc_action_plans: Shared multi-step action planning, checkpoint recovery & Flow state persistence across Core, Plugins, and Apps.
ap_hub_desc: Shared core module across Agent, Coder, Plugins, Apps, and Flows: manages multi-step planning, interactive approval, and automatic resume after crash, timeout, or interruption.
ap_enable_desc: Exposes structured Action Plans to LLM tools (ACTION_PLANS__*), plugins, and Hecos Flows.
ap_mode_confirm: Ask user confirmation before executing steps
ap_mode_manual: Only on explicit request / direct plugin call
ap_min_steps_label: Minimum steps threshold to suggest an automatic plan
ap_expose_presets_label: Expose Action Plans tools to Custom Global Presets (e.g. Hecos Coder)
ap_expose_presets_desc: Automatically includes ACTION_PLANS__* tools when a preset uses operational tools (Executor, Drive, Flows, Browser).
ap_ckpt_enable_desc: Atomically saves agent state, context, and verified workspace files after each chat iteration.
ap_resume_banner_label: Show "Resume Interrupted Work" Banner in Chat WebUI
ap_resume_banner_desc: Displays a banner in chat with the saved iteration and real files verified on disk.
ap_flows_ckpt_desc: Persists completed nodes and context variables between execution waves so interrupted Flows can resume.
ap_chat_revise_placeholder: Ask Architect to revise this plan (e.g. add auth, switch DB, change UI)...
flows_resume_title: Resume from the last saved checkpoint
wr_btn_fix_coder_title: Send error and logs to Hecos Coder for automatic fixing
wr_btn_send_coder_fix_title: Send diagnostics and logs to Hecos Coder to fix the project
wr_toast_debug_sent: Diagnostics sent to Coder Chat and copied to clipboard.
wr_confirm_delete_project: Stop any running processes inside "{name}" and permanently delete it?
wr_toast_opened_trace_cli: Opened Live Coding Action Trace window.
